race.comment: QUEEN OF RUSSIA (10) has the right profile to break through after two placings from as many runs this campaign, the latest a third at this track when sent out favourite and beaten a length and a half by Belinda's Rubi. The 1400m is new, but she is race fit, handled soft ground here and has already beaten BLAZING FUTURE at their recent meeting. BLAZING FUTURE (1) is the logical danger from barrier one after closing off for fourth in the same race, beaten just under two lengths, and he has two placings from seven tries around this distance. MOONYA LAD (4) has been costly but consistent, with five placings from nine starts and a narrow fourth over 1609m at this venue last time. TOWERS HILL (6) brings back-to-back seconds from Bowen and Ewan, and although this is stronger company than last week's picnic placing, his recent form is sound enough to give him a genuine winning chance.
